notes: Draft configuration: The independently mapped full circuit retains the long western straight, northeastern bulb and complete southern inner hairpin and outer return, excluding the northern cut-through and compact kart branches. These course choices match the supplied Speedway Park configuration. The national federation and event organizer identify Speedway Park as the Las Americas venue. The 3142.5 m exact source route remains unscaled against the catalogue 3127 m scalar. Its full branch configuration is retained rather than substituted with a shorter contemporary advertised variant; historical corner alignment remains draft. Branch identity was checked against catalogue layout facts and circuit identification references. Independent source distance 3142.5 m; no coordinates are changed to match a diagram or distance. Travel direction and historical alignment remain provisional.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 76 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
